title: Term, Notice and Exit Charges Printed Against the Vending Services Program
content:
The standard initial term of a Vending Services Program agreement, the written notice required to end it, the charge for each machine removed before the end of the term and the charge for collecting each machine at closure are printed against the programme the agreement is written at.

| Programme | Standard initial term | Written notice required to end the agreement | Charge for each machine removed before the end of the term | Charge for collecting each machine at closure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 12 months | 30 calendar days | 150.00 | 120.00 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 24 months | 30 calendar days | 220.00 | 140.00 |
| Combination Vending Bank | 24 months | 45 calendar days | 380.00 | 180.00 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 36 months | 60 calendar days | 560.00 | 260.00 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 60 months | 90 calendar days | 480.00 | 220.00 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 36 months | 60 calendar days | 720.00 | 310.00 |

The term is stated in whole months and the notice in calendar days. Both charges are amounts in US dollars and both are stated for one machine.

### The two exit charges distinguished

The two charges are separate figures with separate occasions. The first is stated against a machine removed before the end of the term. The second is stated against the collection of a machine at closure. On the Combination Vending Bank they stand at 380.00 and 180.00 for each machine, and on the Campus Vending Network Service at 480.00 and 220.00.

### Worked illustration on a machine complement (hypothetical estate)

An estate of four machines held at the Fresh Food Vending Service, where the charges printed against the programme are 560.00 and 260.00 for each machine, carries 2240.00 where the charge for removal before the end of the term falls on all four, and 1040.00 for the collection of all four. The complement chosen here is illustrative and is not itself a programme figure.

### The schedule read by column

The term runs from 12 months on the Single Machine Snack Service up to 60 months on the Campus Vending Network Service, and the notice from 30 calendar days up to 90 across the same two programmes. Neither exit charge tracks the term: the largest of both, 720.00 and 310.00, belong to the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service, whose term is 36 months.
